title: Design the first-class wizard view schema shape — the ruled spec half of #13342 (proposal returns to the decision box before any implementation)
body:
Spec-first design sub-card created per the #13342 ruling (maintainer, 2026-08-30, director batch #6, verbatim 「13342 A」) by the domain:spec seat (`session_01PBjwYLS6BciTQW3c9xQiD2`). Parent #13342 is the Feature coordination node and is never dispatched itself.

## Deliverable

A **contract-shape PROPOSAL** for the first-class wizard view (步序 / 进度模型 / 「上一步过校验才能进下一步」的闸 — the keys and their semantics), posted on this card. ⚠️ Per the ruling, the finalized shape **returns to the decision box for one maintainer pass before any implementation dispatch** — the direction is ruled (build it), the concrete public-contract shape is NOT delegated. No implementation, no schema edits land from this card.

## Ruled design inputs (from the ruling, binding)

- Boundary with the tabbed form view (it can paginate, has no gate) — the wizard shape must be distinguishable by what it adds, not a synonym.
- objectui#6237's ruled `FormSectionConfig` split: WizardForm's side deliberately has NO predicate slot — if the first-class shape introduces step-level visibility, it must RECONCILE with that ruling, not bypass it.
- ⛔ The costliest failure shape is fenced (already ruled on this board): declaration and implementation land in the SAME wave — never declare the schema and defer the renderer; the fake-teaching channel (#13337 + #13086) was just closed and must not reopen. The proposal must state the two-wave landing plan (spec half + objectui render half with `Blocked-by:`, never co-batched).
- No new teaching material before both halves land (PR #13337 deleted the fake tutorial; gate #13086 pins it).

## Sequencing

After the maintainer passes the shape: implementation cards are filed contract-first (spec schema card, clause-② expected yes, fable + review chain; objectui render sub-card `Blocked-by:` the spec half). None of that is this card's.

Parent: #13342.
